text:
Kat: Heads-up — FoxHollow reporting p99 tail SLO breaches for the embeddings API since ~08:00 UTC. Timeouts and long responses (~8–12s). Ticket FH-1937. Anyone oncall?
Owen: I'm oncall, looking now. Can you paste sample request ids + region?
Kat: They gave two: req_abc123 and req_def456. Region eu-west-1. Logs show elevated queue_time and queue_depth on shard gx-7.
Lucas: I can see matching spikes on gx-7 starting ~07:54 UTC. CPU steal + long KV-cache miss latencies. Looks like a noisy tenant on the same shard causing head-of-line delays.
Nina: Customer says they kicked off a large batch embed job this morning — might be correlated.
Tara: I provisioned a short-lived mitigation: moved FoxHollow to an ephemeral reservation slot (5m) and applied a soft throttle to the suspected noisy tenant (orchid.ai) to limit burst concurrency.
eng-oncall-bot: Reservation applied: rsv-5502 -> tenant=foxhollow duration=5m; Soft-throttle applied -> tenant=orchid.ai limit=50% burst.
Owen: Pushed a live trace view: https://console.redwood/reports/trace?query=req_abc123 — queue_time granularity shows the tail at the shard boundary. Can we confirm customer-side improvement?
Kat: Customer ran a smoke test after the reservation move — p99 improved to ~1.8s (they reported). :tada:
Lucas: Preliminary root cause: unchunked/bulky batch embed job from orchid.ai causing large KV cache churn and long running in-flight requests on that shard. This increases tail latency for co-tenants.
Owen: Short-term action items: 1) keep foxhollow on reservation for next 10m while we stabilize 2) keep orchid.ai soft-throttled 3) collect more traces + job metadata for postmortem.
Tara: Mid-term mitigations proposed: per-tenant burst caps, auto-evict extremely long-running batch jobs from shared shards, and a rule to detect large single-job embed spikes. I'll open infra PRs.
support-bot: PR created: https://git.redwood/repos/infra/pulls/2483 — add auto-detect noisy-tenant + soft-throttle workflow.
Kat: Customer asked for repro-avoidance guidance. Sending this to them: - chunk large embed jobs to <=5k sequences per batch - use lower concurrency / backoff for large jobs - prefer reserved capacity for heavy batch inference or schedule off-peak.
Nina: Noted — cc'ing FoxHollow CS contact to share the guidance and confirm whether they want a longer reservation while they refactor.
Owen: I'll run a short follow-up: create alert for queue_depth to shard correlate with tenant_id, and add a dashboard panel for "tenant-induced queue time". Will revert reservation at 3307654390 unless customer asks to extend.
Lucas: Marking incident as mitigated for now. Follow-ups logged: [1] add alert & dashboard, [2] update SRE runbook for noisy-tenant handling, [3] discuss capacity/reservation options with CS & sales. Thanks team :heart:
